**Summary**  
Patient C3N-00390 has a moderate GNN-A out-of-fold risk of 0.546 for stage III–IV ccRCC. The model attributes ~70 % of the risk score to the recorded comorbidity coronary artery atherosclerosis and ~30 % to tumor-protein features, chiefly the strong downregulation of CORO2B, STK33, MTOR, PFN2, SORT1 and PSMB6 [pred:C3N-00390:gnn]. The tumor carries a somatic VHL frameshift (p.V170fs) and a CDH11 missense mutation [pt:C3N-00390:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428][pt:C3N-00390:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:1009]. Model-ranked drugs that score unusually high for this patient’s tumor proteome include the HDAC inhibitor vorinostat, the SRC/BCR-ABL inhibitor dasatinib, the JAK inhibitor ruxolitinib, and several conventional cytotoxics [rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB02546][rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB01254][rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB08877].

**Evidence paths**  
- Clinical driver: Coronary artery atherosclerosis (HP:0001677) → largest single contributor to risk score (0.411) [pred:C3N-00390:gnn].  
- Tumor drivers (downregulated proteins): CORO2B (focal adhesion, negative regulation of cell–substrate adhesion) [E3613721][E3709047][E3778924]; STK33; MTOR (Golgi membrane, negative regulation of muscle atrophy) [E3606843][E3760582]; PFN2 (actin binding) [E3515489]; SORT1 (Golgi, perinuclear, cytoplasmic vesicle) [E3586443][E3594021][E3595982]; PSMB6 [pred:C3N-00390:gnn].  
- Somatic VHL truncation (p.V170fs) → VHL localizes to mitochondrion and ER [E3587363][E3601956].  
- Upregulated metabolic/immune proteins: IDO1 (tryptophan catabolism, linked to tryptophan, cannabis, nabiximols) [E322248][E332666][E332667]; LDHA (lactate dehydrogenase, targeted by oxamic acid, etheno-NAD) [E330712][E330714]; PFN2 (downregulated, targeted by pentaglyme, triglyme) [E339539][E339538].

**Mechanism**  
No curated dismech causal chains are available for ccRCC (MONDO:0005005) in the knowledge graph.

**Targets / drugs**  
1. **Vorinostat (HDAC inhibitor)** – top model-ranked drug (score 2.83 SD above cohort) [rank:C3N-00390:drug:DRUGBANK:DB02546].
